title: English Teacher
description:
• Full-time, ongoing
  • Commencing Term 1, 2027
  • Salary commensurate with years of Service
  • Continuous professional development opportunities
  • Generous staff benefits


English at Pembroke is taught by a large, dynamic team across Years 7 to 12, spanning both SACE and the International Baccalaureate. Our Middle School curriculum has been recently redesigned around conceptual threads and a portfolio-based approach to assessment that prioritises the process of learning, not just its products. Our teachers enjoy considerable freedom in text selection, within a framework of high academic expectations, and our faculty culture is one of collegiality, intellectual curiosity and serious engagement with pedagogy. Our staff contribute to curriculum design, and are supported to grow as practitioners at every career stage.


About the Role

Successful applicants will teach across the secondary years, with allocations shaped by experience and strengths. Depending on the appointment, this may include Middle School classes, senior SACE English subjects, or IB Diploma Language A courses.


Key Responsibilities include:

  • Delivering engaging, rigorous and innovative English lessons that foster a love of learning
  • Supporting students to develop strong literacy, analytical and communication skills
  • Providing purposeful assessment and feedback that supports every students' growth
  • Contributing to a positive and collaborative culture across the Middle and Senior Schools
  • Actively participating in the life of the School through co-curricular and pastoral care contributions.


About You

You are an effective teacher first and foremost, with demonstrated impact on student learning and a command of your subject that lets you teach with both rigour and imagination.


You will bring:

  • Strong subject knowledge and a love of literature and language that students can feel
  • Evidence-informed, responsive pedagogy and high expectations of every learner
  • Capacity or willingness to teach across SACE and IB pathways (IB experience is valued but not required; training and support are provided)
  • Strong communication with students, families and colleagues
  • A collaborative disposition and a genuine interest in contributing to faculty and school life


Applications at All Career Stages

We welcome applications from experienced practitioners and from graduate and early-career teachers alike. Early-career appointees are supported through structured mentoring and induction as part of a faculty that takes professional growth seriously.


Required for Employment (Prior to Commencement)

  • Current Working with Children Check (South Australia)
  • Current Plink RRHAN-EC training: Masterclass and Fundamentals, including Protective Practices
  • First Aid and CPR


Find Your Place At Pembroke

At Pembroke, youâll be part of a warm and collaborative school community that values relationships, initiative, and a shared commitment to learning. Whether in the classroom, on the sporting field, or behind the scenes, every role contributes to shaping the rich and inclusive culture of the School. With opportunities for professional growth, a strong sense of belonging, and a genuine appreciation for staff, Pembroke is a place where your work is seen, valued, and celebrated.


Read more in The Heart of Pembroke - Celebrating our Staff.


Pembroke School is a co-educational, non-denominational, day and boarding School from Early Learning Centre to Year 12. Renowned for academic excellence and a broad, inclusive program, Pembroke offers the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) and is also an International Baccalaureate World School, offering the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Primary Years Programme (PYP).


Pembroke is a vibrant and exciting School catering for a diverse community of students. With over 1,700 students, the School offers a broad-ranging curriculum and an outstanding choice of co-curricular opportunities. The School employs over 300 permanent and fixed-term staff, plus more than 150 casual employees.


Pembroke seeks to engage outstanding, diverse and well-qualified staff to work in our welcoming and open School. All staff work together to provide an environment that facilitates each studentâs exploration of their potential, academic progress and personal welfare. Staff are encouraged to maintain a collaborative approach, a broad outlook within their respective field and a commitment to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement. Pembroke is a lively and fulfilling place to work.


How to Apply

Applications for this position close on Sunday, 6 September 2026, at 11:59 pm.


  • You are required to upload a CV and a cover letter (maximum 2 pages) identifying your interest in applying and what you could bring to the role.
  • Your application should be addressed to the Acting Principal, Mr Chris Zielinski.
  • The School reserves the right to shortlist and interview candidates before the closing date. Early applications are strongly encouraged.
  • For any enquiries regarding this position, please email talent@pembroke.sa.edu.au
  • Please do not email your applications.
  • Late applications and those submitted via external recruitment agencies will not be considered.


Pembroke School is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Store Manager
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether youâre welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. youâre not expected to fit a mold. Youâre encouraged to break it and create something better.

Overview

As the Store Manager, you will lead a dedicated team of store associates & leaders every day, to create an exceptional consumer experience.â¯ Your focus will be on driving sales, providing excellent customer service, maintaining visual presentations, and developing talent within the store. This role offers opportunity to grow and collaborate with industry leading teammates and partners.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver outstanding service to our consumers using our C.H.A.R.M service model
  • Leads the store team in surpassing performance metrics including sales, consumer service and charms
  • Apply analytical thinking & company reporting to find opportunities within store, empowering the team to make strategic decisions
  • Lead visual presentation, product flow, replenishment, and operational standards throughout the store
  • Foster a welcoming, inclusive environment that engages promotes internal growth and builds an external network of talent
  • Coordinate, delegate, prioritize and meet store deadlines while ensuring effective follow up on daily activities
  • Contribute to crafting a team environment that encourages sharing of suggestions, ideas, and concerns while upholding Crocs Inc. values
  • Learn & assist in various departments including consumer service, product knowledge, visual presentation, and stock room management.
  • Support team members in the daily execution of retail operations i.e., POS system management and use, stock replenishment, assist in pricing and markdown processes seasonally, promote loyalty programs, maintain cleanliness and recovery standards etc.
  • Adhere to Crocs, Inc. Asset Protection policies and procedures, including shortage prevention, inventory control, and compliance procedures

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • Minimum 18+ years old
  • Possess at least A Level / SSCE/ Diploma / Advanced Diploma or above preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of total retail experience; preferably with previous Store Manager experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a passion for challenging, empowering, and driving team results
  • Professional working proficiency in English, proficiency of other language(s) will be an advantage
  • Proven communication skills (written and verbal) to successfully connect with store team, operations managers, District Managers & corporate partners
  • Flexible to work on rotational shift basis, including nights, Saturdays, Sundays and Public Holidays.
  • Intermediate computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Email and able to operate retail Point of Sale system
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a passion for challenging, empowering, and driving team results
  • Desire to succeed in a high growth, fast-paced retail environment
  • The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of but not limited to those that an employee will encounter while performing the essential functions of this job.
  • Ability to climb and descend ladders carrying merchandise daily
  • Ability to lift 15kg or more with assistance daily

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.â¯This posting is for an existing vacany and we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other classification protected by law.

Title: Store Manager

The posted pay range reflects geographic market conditions and may vary by location. Compensation will always meet or exceed applicable local minimum wage requirements.

This position is eligible to participate in a company incentive program.

This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, and many other additional voluntary benefits. This organization participates in E-Verify

title: Sourcer Private Destinations
description:
Journey with us! Combine your career goals and sense of adventure by joining our incredible team of employees at Royal Caribbean Group. We are proud to offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, and excellent career development opportunities, each offering unique ways to explore the world.

We are proud to be the vacation-industry leader with global brands â including Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea Cruises â the most innovative fleet and private destinations, and the best people. Together, we are dedicated to turning the vacation of a lifetime into a lifetime of vacations for our guests.

Royal Caribbean Groupâs Shipboard Recruiting team has an exciting career opportunity for a full time Sourcer, Private Destinations reporting to the Director, Shipboard Recruiting.

This position will reside in Nassau Bahamas and will sit in our main office.

Position Summary

The Sourcer executes all strategic sourcing activities in partnership with the Private Destinations talent acquisition initiatives across entry levels and functions.

The goal is to ensure that the organization can consistently proactively deploy the right people, in the right place, at the right time, at the most efficient cost, and for them to be fully engaged.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Builds and implements sourcing strategy.
  • Understands and executes current trends and best practices in sourcing and talent attraction.
  • Builds talent pipelines from various platforms such as social media, job boards, niche sites, and other similar platforms to implement sourcing strategy.
  • Creates candidate pipeline ahead of need and real time.
  • Leverages proprietary pipelines of candidates through our ATS and CRM.
  • Collaborates with recruiters to develop market strategy, pipeline candidates, provide insights, and share competitive intelligence.
  • Partners with the necessary team(s) to establish, develop, and maintain relationships with hiring managers.
  • Provides support of inbound sourcing (candidate / req management) as needed.
  • Assists with recruitment marketing and events initiatives.
  • Help support candidates with applications.
  • Assists with overseeing Smartsheet trackers.
  • Meets operational business goals and KPIâs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelorâs degree in human resource management, business administration, or related field from an accredited college or university or the international equivalent required.
  • Minimum two (2) yearsâ experience in working for a global/international or reputable local organization in the same capacity.
  • Working knowledge of computers, internet access, and the ability to navigate within an automated HRIS system as well as variety software packages such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; familiar with social media and relevant company/brand efforts.
  • Good working knowledge in recruitment strategies and talent pool management
  • Knowledge of accepted human resources practices and the laws governing employment and fair treatment of employees globally.
  • Must be tactful, resolute, and committed to providing excellent customer service.
  • Must have a flexible approach to change, is able to work effectively in a variety of situations, seeks improvements and looks to the future.
  • Strong written and presentational skills; ability to clearly communicate complex messages to a variety of audiences including management.
  • Ability to work with colleagues, managers, and stakeholders in effective partnership.

We know there's a lot to consider. As you go through the application process, our recruiters will be glad to provide guidance, and more relevant details to answer any additional questions. Thank you again for your interest in Royal Caribbean Group. We'll hope to see you onboard soon!

title: Renewables Project Scheduler
description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

TAKKION is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Salary Description

$90,000-$130,000
